en: The image shows a historic European town with a prominent iron bridge in the foreground, several people walking, and a horse cart crossing the bridge. A large Gothic-style church with a tall tower dominates the background, standing on a hill above the town's rooftops. The buildings have distinct early 20th-century central European architecture. There are visible shop signs on the buildings, including 'Germania-Droger' and 'Fleischerei.'
